sources: https://cms3.revize.com/revize/kandiyohicounty/Document%20Center/County%20Parks/PROPOSED%202026%20Park%20fee%20and%20policy.pdf ('KANDIYOHI COUNTY PARK POLICIES 2026 RATES', linked from the county parks page as '2026 County Park Policy and Fees')

values.note: 2026: $34 a day plus tax; stays of 30 days or more $32 a day with no sales tax; tent sites $25; dogs $1 per dog per day of the reservation.

fees.source: Kandiyohi County 2026 park policies and rates PDF ('Big Kandiyohi Lake County Park West Daily Fees 0-29 days $34.00 plus tax 30 PLUS Days $32.00 Tent sites $25.00'; '(30 days or longer stays are not subject to sales tax)'; 'Dog's fees are $1.00 per dog/per day'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online only, through the county's ResNexus page; registration opens in January (January 20, 2026), with seasonal campers given the first seven days. From Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day a reservation must run 7 or more consecutive days; before and after that, sites rent by the day. Full payment at booking, credit card only.

booking.source: Kandiyohi County 2026 park policies PDF ('Reservations must be for 7 or more continuous days, except for designated tenting camp sites and Pre-Memorial Day Weekend and Post Labor Day, campsites maybe rented by the day.'; 'Effective January 20th, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ONLY On-Line camping reservations will be taken'; 'Seasonal Campers get the first seven days to register.') + county parks page (Big Kandiyohi Lake West 'Sites' -> ResNexus), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: https://www.kcmn.us/departments/county_parks/index.php ('Big Kandiyohi County Park West has 94 campsites') + 2026 policies PDF ('Big Kandiyohi Lake County Park West 94'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.kcmn.us/departments/county_parks/index.php amenity table (Big Kandi West: Boat Rental, Bait, Camp Store, Camping Pads, Seasonal Rates, Gas, Snack Bar), read 2026-11-11

note: Kandiyohi County park on a peninsula in Big Kandiyohi Lake, 10 mi S of Willmar, with a swim beach and boat access. One row of sites lines the open east shore of the peninsula. --Claude
summary: County page and 2026 policy PDF read: 94 sites, $34 plus tax (30+ day stays $32), online-only booking on ResNexus opening each January with seasonal campers first, and a 7-consecutive-day minimum from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day. DROP CANDIDATE on the summer 7-night minimum (same county rule that dropped Green Lake County Park in p3-412). Lakefront kept for the east-shore row on imagery; site numbers unread.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (standing summer minimum / long-stay character): the county's 2026 policy: 'Reservations must be for 7 or more continuous days, except for designated tenting camp sites and Pre-Memorial Day Weekend and Post Labor Day, campsites maybe rented by the day.'
